author: Chris Graves
text: First cut of the fill rate analyzer is merged. It reads the daily order-line export and prints fill rate by site. Sample data is seeded so everyone gets the same numbers.

author: Priya Okafor
text: Can we split this by SKU family? Spare Parts drag our number down and I need to show that separately in the weekly review.

author: Alex Moreno
text: Done - SKU family grouping is in 1.1.0. Older files without the column still load and show as 'Unassigned'.

author: Jordan Tate
text: Script crashed on last night's run: ZeroDivisionError. Indianapolis had a day with zero ordered units after the holiday cutoff.

author: Chris Graves
text: Patched in 1.1.1. Fill rate now returns 0 for empty buckets, and shipped > ordered rows get clamped. Search the code for [CHG-091] to see the exact lines.

author: Jordan Tate
text: Added on-time ship rate. Fill rate alone hid the fact that Memphis ships complete but late.

author: Alex Moreno
text: Heads up: 2.0.0 is a breaking change. Output is now an HTML report instead of CSV, so any Power Automate flow that picks up the CSV needs updating.

author: Priya Okafor
text: The new report is much easier to share with site leads. The trend tab made our Spare Parts dip obvious.

author: Chris Graves
text: Adding change log and team communication tabs so reviewers can see why each version exists without leaving the report. Targeting 2.1.0 tomorrow.

author: Jordan Tate
text: Reviewed and approved. Message text is escaped before embedding, so markup like this shows as plain text.
